description: Use when both the agent and MCP endpoint are reachable but tool schema, capability negotiation or interoperability is failing. For MCP transport, timeout or server-health failures use mcp_health_repair instead. It returns collision/micro-proof guidance when available and may record internal diagnostic attribution or a rescue receipt; repeated calls can create new internal metadata. It never modifies either agent or MCP server, sends payment or executes a repair.

text.description: Sanitized, non-sensitive symptom text. Include the observable failure and status/error class when known; never include secrets, credentials or private keys.
